title: Mozilla ie faster css javascript download win

change.control: Existing slow English IE landing page.
change.variant: Combine or remove JavaScript files and inline CSS, reducing average page load time by 2.2 seconds.

significance.reported: One-sided Student’s t-test; publisher reports P=0.000051 for a means difference of 14%.

quote: In reality, our optimized experimental variation shaved 2.2 seconds off the average page load time and increased download conversions by 15.4%!
notes: 275,000 daily visitors is traffic context, not the test sample. Source mixes a 15.4% observed lift with a t-test described using a 14% difference; do not reinterpret its statistics or projections as observed incremental downloads. Business type reflects the nonprofit-owned browser organization; the conversion is a browser download, not a SaaS subscription.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
